author: Universe Scales
note: Original dimensioned diagram of the 305 m primary reflector only, as a spherical cap with 265 m curvature radius. Geometry uses equal horizontal and vertical metres. This is an idealized intact, pre-December-2020 surface, not the observatory’s present condition. The rectangular texture approximates the published 3 × 6 ft aluminum panels, but is not a survey of their layout. Feed cabin/platform, suspension towers, cable network, surrounding ground and support structure are omitted. The zero-thickness, double-sided surface does not assert a solid metal bowl or a shell thickness; colors and reflections are illustrative.
